name: kitchen-cooking-detection
goal: HA detects cooking from the kitchen Awair, reminds us to close an open kid's door, and purges the kids' rooms at 100% until Bedtime.

userStories.title: Calibrate from history
userStories.description: Simulate candidate rules over the recorder.
acceptanceCriteria: Thresholds chosen from data and recorded in prd.md

userStories.title: Detection sensor
acceptanceCriteria: PM2.5 jump >= 8 with kitchen occupied, delay_on 3 min, delay_off 30 min

userStories.title: Door reminder
userStories.description: Announce open kids' doors once, repeat once after 10 min.
acceptanceCriteria: Gated on house occupied and an open door

userStories.title: Purge
userStories.description: Flag + on/off automations + script override for kids' purifiers.
acceptanceCriteria: Manual 100 while flag on and room not Bedtime

userStories.title: Docs
userStories.description: Kitchen README/LEARNINGS, air quality README, docs/AUTOMATIONS.md.
